tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search creator-recommended products by keyword. Returns title, price, store domain, store rating and a link to the product page on Avahit.

tools.name: compare_alternatives
tools.description: Given an Avahit product id, return ranked alternatives with a match percentage explaining how close each one is (same category, price distance, product type, same store).

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Given an Avahit product id, return what Avahit itself observed about its price: current price and when it was last verified against the store, the lowest and highest price seen with dates, the average, how many checks and since when. Amazon products have no history — Amazon's licence forbids keeping
